The huskies were led by thirteenth year head coach [[Lorenzo Romar]]. The Huskies played their home games at [[Alaska Airlines Arena at Hec Edmundson Pavilion|Alaska Airlines Arena]] at Hec Edmundson Pavilion as members of the [[Pac-12 Conference men's basketball|Pac-12 Conference]]. They finished the season 16–15, 5–13 in Pac-12 play to finish in eleventh place. They lost in the first round of the [[2015 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 tournament]] to Stanford. == Previous season == The [[2013–14 Washington Huskies men's basketball team|2013–14 Washington Huskies]] finished the season with an overall record of 17–15, and 9–9 in the Pac-12 regular season.
